stem.text: There is a high concentration of molecule X outside the cell which enters the cell by facilitated diffusion. The results of measuring the concentration of X inside the cell at $30\,\text{s}$ intervals are shown by the graph.

stem.alt: Graph of concentration of X inside cell against time/s: concentration stays low for about 50 s, rises steeply, then levels off after about 150 s

stem.text: Why does the concentration of X inside the cell remain constant after $150\,\text{s}$?

items: There is no more of X outside the cell.
The number of carrier proteins is limiting.
There is no net movement of X.
